# Discovery gap fixtures

These three illustrations were drawn locally with simple polygons and shapes on November 17, 2026. No customer image, production business record or external asset is included. They are synthetic object illustrations, not representative real shoe/bag photographs.

- `stacked-books-illustration.png`: deliberate cross-domain query against the existing real book-cover fixtures. The current fallback abstains; the test requires honest category navigation rather than fabricated image results. This is not the original Buyer screenshot.
- `shoe-illustration.png` and `bag-illustration.png`: exact-image retrieval controls for isolated test listings. Passing proves that the same illustration is retrievable, not that an unseen shoe/bag is recognized semantically.

The 19 existing real catalog-photo fixtures remain under `tests/Fixtures/visual-search/`.
